labels.reason: API00-C internal-only-API FP pattern; also factually wrong: while(vlan_gsm) loop already guards every deref of gsm/vlan_gsm.
gsm is genuinely read-only (only vlan_gsm mutated); plain lookup helper, not a vtable/eloop callback slot. DCL13-C plain-helper TP pattern.
confused local automatic-storage pointer variable with local storage; vlan_gsm always points to heap (os_zalloc'd) wpa_group nodes, matches comeback_token.c FP class.
wpa_auth_get_first_sta_seen only reads wpa_auth->group; matches b54's wpa_auth_get_*/sta_*/pmksa_* accessor TP pattern (not a registered callback).

wpa_select_vlan_wpa_group non-null-by-construction pattern (b52/b53): wpa_init fails wpa_init() itself if wpa_group_init fails, so wpa_auth->group is always non-NULL once wpa_auth exists; gsm input here can't be NULL, so callee can't return NULL.
